skins.name: Newsgirl
skins.description: Available only in certain regions, this remake of a classic design utilizes the best materials and contains carefully-sewn details. An extra custom-made letter opener is included.
skins.howToObtain: Certificate Store ( 40 Distinction Certificate or 400 Universal Certificate )

skins.name: Fresh Fastener
skins.description: An outfit worn by Amiya while working for a Rhodes Island restaurant. This poofy coat is cold-resistant, and has enough room to hold something penguin-sized.
skins.howToObtain: Certificate Store ( 40 Distinction Certificate or 400 Universal Certificate )

skins.name: The Law
skins.description: The jailer garments Saria used when entering Mansfield State Prison , largely in line with the female jailer's standard uniform.

skins.name: Seedsower
skins.description: A loose yet comfortable outdoors fit. Comes with an exclusive miniature mountain-grade rucksack and an agricultural nursery kit. The designer has one small wish of her own, and hopes that we can all help to realize it.

skins.name: Focus
skins.description: The attire Phantom wore when he left for the castle, and the costume for his maiden performance. After an age of gathering dust, it finally sees the light of day again.

skins.name: Traceless Walker
skins.description: Custom-made by the Lateran for certain Legati. Sankta who get custom outfits all share a common feature: there is something unusual about their halos.

skins.name: Snowstorm Invitation
skins.description: An outfit tailor-made by Karlan Trade for their affiliated business negotiators. First impressions are of the utmost importance in trade talks. Steward knows this well, and has never failed to live up to expectations.
skins.release: Snow Upon Autumnal Winds Login Event

skins.name: Summer Feast
skins.description: Mizuki wears this when feasting on the beach. The material is stain-resistant and provides plenty of room for extra appendages.

skins.name: Midnight Delivery
skins.description: As part of our cooperation agreement, Rhodes Island ordered this operator uniform for Exusiai. She can be seen wearing it, from time to time, during operations in Lungmen.
skins.howToObtain: Packs Store ( Prelude to Dawn Pack )

skins.name: Bunch of Sunlight
skins.description: Outfit specially designed for going out. It uses the operator's main color as basic tone and matches it with a different-colored jacket for a vivid contrast.

skins.name: After Storm
skins.description: Frost inevitably gives way to a clear day. Ch'en Hui-chieh patrols the city in her first L.G.D. uniform, re-inspecting the metropolis both familiar and foreign to her.
skins.howToObtain: Packs Store ( Perish in Frost Pack )

skins.name: Phase Face
skins.description: Clothes that show off both Tin Man's classical and surrealist sides. The final design was put together using Furnace illusions. A sense of strangeness blurs the line between illusion and reality.

skins.name: Allmind As One
skins.description: A possibility derived from when Executor connected to the Law : connected consciousnesses tend towards unity, all to achieve one goal. Exsequi. Exsequi. Exsequi.
skins.image: /six-star-skins/Executor the Ex Foedere - Allmind As One.webp

skins.name: Solo Around The World
skins.code: Test Birthday Collection 1101/Solo Around The World
skins.description: The Ark cradling the cocoon of dreams sailed into the galaxy, dissolving into millions of threads. With love as their needle, the many hands crafted a one-of-a-kind garment for Amiya. The remaining threads, intertwined with wishes, were fashioned into a violin.

skins.name: Glory to the Devout
skins.code: Test Collection Series/Glory to the Devout
skins.description: Nun's habit that has been altered, with adjustments for the wearer's racial characteristics. Paired with accessories that reflect one's personal style.

skins.name: The Remains of Time
skins.code: Test Collection Series/The Remains of Time
skins.description: An outfit worn by Kal'tsit while in disguise. Countless times, in this manner, she influenced the course of Terra's civilization—ripples in the great river of time, a fleeting mark on her endless journey.
skins.howToObtain: Packs Store ( Rise from Ember Pack )

skins.name: Unruly Humbleness
skins.description: Bartender and bar-owner Lappland, with some of her colleagues in tow, happily welcomes in tonight's employer and Boss.

skins.name: An Airy Dream
skins.description: Rosmontis's lavender dream. In this dream, soft flowers bloom deep in her memories, and Rosmontis's skirt billows with the wind, leaping towards a light future with her companions.

skins.name: Letters from Wessex
skins.description: A uniform from Victoria 's Wessex Middle School, adapted by traditional Victorian designers. Centuries of rich heritage combines with excellent craftsmanship to make a light and comfortable outfit.
skins.howToObtain: Certificate Store ( 40 Distinction Certificate or 400 Universal Certificate )

skins.name: Combat Medic
skins.description: Based upon a special-issue Ádakrys battlesuit, it has blades attached in the right parts to give off an extremely aggressive look. Gavial describes it as her ideal "battlefield trappings."

skins.name: Serenity
skins.description: Casual clothing centered around black and purple as main colors to exude a bit of elegance while still maintaining a calm feel. A favorite among women in the workplace, this outfit was Ptilopsis's first choice when going out.

skins.name: Invisible Dirge
skins.description: Taking the model's peculiar traits in consideration, this outfit was completed without being tailored. Combines comfort, fashion, and a proper fit while also protecting the operator's vitals.
skins.howToObtain: Crystallization Sanctuary ( 980 Crystal Contract Bounty ) Certificate Store ( 40 Distinction Certificate or 400 Universal Certificate )

skins.name: Spellbreaker
skins.description: A Laterano dress with corresponding weapons. Generally, only Sankta who have presided over the ceremonies are allowed to wear it, and Mostima seems to have quietly snuck out with this outfit.

skins.name: Miraculous Moment
skins.description: Casual clothes that capture the region's impressions while taking the customer's preferences in consideration. After a deep dive into the customer's life, the designer collaborated with the customer to add a variety of supporting accessories.
skins.release: Grani and the Knights' Treasure Rerun

skins.name: Fugue
skins.description: Ordinary Sarkaz mercenary wear. Easy to mend, protective, and carries even more explosives after simple modification.

skins.name: Eggcellent Craftsman
skins.description: Greyy made an exquisite eight-tone musical egg as a present for his close friends, and in exchange, they custom-ordered him this outfit brimming with holiday atmosphere.
skins.howToObtain: Certificate Store ( 40 Distinction Certificate or 400 Universal Certificate )

skins.name: Leisurely Afternoon
skins.description: Home leisure style, relaxed and pleasing to the eye, graceful and cozy. Comes with a pair of adorable fitted slippers, for a afternoon completely free of cares wherever you are.

skins.name: Bard's Holiday
skins.description: Trendy autumn attire, loose and breathable. Incorporates a unique multi-layer pocket design, convenient for holding all sorts of lightweight souvenirs during a serendipitous sojourn.

skins.name: Glory Purple
skins.description: Zofia's attire when she participated in the Kazimierz Major awards ceremony. The right choice of attire made her the center of attention during the ceremony.

skins.name: Heritage
skins.description: Traditional Minoan ritual attire, coordinated with modern themes, is once again in vogue among Minoans.

skins.name: Gift of Wild
skins.code: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Gift of Wild
skins.description: The choice of the Columbian pioneer, with a core emphasis on strong and durable design. The added details give this outfit that extra personal touch.

skins.name: Appreciate Fragrance
skins.description: Finely-crafted Victorian dress, handmade from the finest materials. An elegant and dignified outfit bound to garner attention anywhere.

skins.name: Book Reader
skins.description: Traditional Victorian textiles and tailoring, every cut made by the hands of craftsmen, its custom-made monochrome cloth premium without being conspicuous.

skins.name: Justice Maker
skins.description: Attire of Wild Mane during repairs of "Justice Knight." Cozy and breathable, while wear and stain resistant. Detailing and accessories in contrasting colors coordinated to embody that sense of planning.

skins.name: Become Anew
skins.description: Rosmontis's attire while still a test subject, adorned only by detectors and inhibitors.

skins.name: Ingenious Servant
skins.description: A bespoke outfit ordered at the Savile Boutique Tailors by Kjera, the finished product of bewildering quality thanks to the fantastic minds of the designers, plus Kjera's own clever touch.

skins.name: A Drip of Orea and Potamous
skins.code: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/A Drip of Orea and Potamous
skins.description: Designed for the climate of Minos , slim-fitting and easy to move in. The fabric is durable, waterproof, and resistant to the occasional spilled wine. Can be customized with extras to the customer's needs.
skins.howToObtain: Prosperity Gradient ( 1500 Badge of Prosperity milestone)
skins.image: /six-star-skins/Pallas - A Drip of Orea and Potamous.webp

skins.name: Under A Veil
skins.code: EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Under A Veil
skins.description: Manticore once wore it on a mission in Sargon, and was bothered by the clanging of the gold accessories as she moved.

skins.name: Paper Wing
skins.description: White jacket on mint-green T-shirt, refreshingly cool for the summer.

skins.name: Betsushi
skins.description: Traditional clothing of Higashi . It is meticulously crafted from high-quality fabrics, with vibrant colors and elegant patterns. The design is comfortable and warm, making it suitable for autumn outings.

skins.name: Fantastic Crafts
skins.description: Astesia and her sister wore this for a machine design competition. Lightweight, durable, and easy to clean, a stylish outfit for a hard-worker.
skins.howToObtain: Crystallization Sanctuary ( 980 Crystal Contract Bounty ) Certificate Store ( 40 Distinction Certificate or 400 Universal Certificate )

skins.name: A Thousand Correspondences
skins.code: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/A Thousand Correspondences
skins.description: A custom outfit made of fine and lightweight material, tailored based on Heidi's descriptions of her childhood summers. Though it feels different from how she remembers.

skins.name: Her Aspiration
skins.description: The clothes Astgenne wore in her rented home. A lab coat thrown over an elegant and close fit, for she must always be ready for a whimsical stroke of inspiration for her experiments.

skins.name: Sunny Day
skins.description: Cardigan's outfit when she had just arrived at a city in southern Leithanien . Skillfully tailored to fit a young girl's stature. Light, airy, and blooming with vitality.
skins.howToObtain: Reach Level 35 in Cognitive Diving Evaluation

skins.name: The Other Side of Siracusa
skins.code: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/The Other Side of Siracusa
skins.description: Does he not occasionally wear a plain jacket and hoodie instead of a tailored suit, and sit-down at a not-quite traditional Siracusan restaurant?

skins.name: Gwiazdcytrony
skins.description: Meteor's winter clothes from back in Kazimierz. Balancing lightness and warmth, they also allow one to easily hide in dense forests. A reproduction.

skins.name: Amidst the Pieces
skins.code: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Amidst the Pieces
skins.description: Puzzle knows that he should tailor his attire to his target—one of the most efficient ways to win trust and exchange intel. When alone, however, he barely spares a thought to his appearance.

skins.name: Curator
skins.description: Scholar's garb straight from a fairy tale. Stuff your magic, knowledge, and curiosity in the pockets, and take notes with Reed.

skins.name: Courtesy
skins.description: Lungmen 's latest trend, seamlessly blending ancient and modern Yanese charm. To Qiubai, the art of tea and the sword are the same in that both require full attention and to know when to stop.

skins.name: Habitat
skins.description: Silence's dress for public events. She's been busy of late, and drifts to sleep in front of the camera. Luckily, she has Ifrit 's handmade alarm clock to help her stay awake.

skins.name: For the Banquet
skins.code: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/For the Banquet
skins.description: Melanite once attended a banquet hosting people from across the industry. On careful consideration, she chose this gown to hide her true purpose for attending.

skins.name: A Picnic Before A Long Trip
skins.code: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/A Picnic Before A Long Trip
skins.description: Bam! Everyone's become teeny-tiny, must be another one of Dolly 's pranks! Good thing the cream didn't stain her dress, because Eyjafjalla will need it for a dance of azure blue.
skins.release: Adventure That Cannot Wait for the Sun
skins.image: /six-star-skins/Eyjafjalla the Hvít Aska - A Picnic Before A Long Trip.webp

skins.name: Vibrant
skins.description: Clothes Enis wears when he's in a good mood. Specially chosen for him by his family. Close-fitting, snug and easy to move around in.

skins.name: Il Segreto Della Notte
skins.code: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Il Segreto Della Notte
skins.description: A form-fitting combination of tailored clothes and exquisite accessories, displaying one's status without drawing too much attention. Comes with a VIP Carnevale invitation and too many balloons.
skins.image: /six-star-skins/Texas the Omertosa - Il Segreto Della Notte.webp

skins.name: Sun Slant
skins.description: After sorting through his attic, Diamante finally pieced together a web connecting the nobles to the mining accident twenty years ago. As he rubs his aching neck, the sunlight seeps in through the window.

skins.name: Cover Mercenary
skins.description: Clothes Quartz wore when she was invited to a magazine shoot. Minimalist yet stylish, daring yet elegant. A mercenary's aura adds a touch of mystique to this outfit.

skins.name: Echo of Bagpipes
skins.code: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Echo of Bagpipes
skins.description: Clothes Bagpipe wears when she heads home. No need for any fancy accessories. A simple dress and a bright smile are enough to charm even the critters frolicking by her side.

skins.name: Tons of Sunshine
skins.code: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Tons of Sunshine
skins.description: Clothes Wanqing wears for work. White singlet, tight-fitting yet breathable pants, and a dirt-repellent apron. A simple ensemble that becomes harmony itself on him.

skins.name: Midskog Fika
skins.description: Celebratory dress prepared by Valarqvin for a rare day of melted snow. Adorned with bright grass and flower motifs, which are infused with beautiful meaning in Sami .

skins.name: Playfellows
skins.description: Comfy casual clothes Vermeil changed into, sharing the dolls she collected with everyone at the party. Who would've thought she had such a cute collection?

skins.name: Bard by the Lake
skins.code: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Bard by the Lake
skins.description: Attire Cantabile wore during her lakeside holiday. The white of the dress is in perfect harmony with the natural environment, creating a tranquil, dream-like ambience.

skins.name: Stranded
skins.description: Recreation of clothes Highmore wore in her hometown. Custom-made flexible support materials keep the skirt puffy, while ribbons of pure white gently sway, giving form to the unknowable sea breeze.

skins.name: Laminar Flow
skins.description: Clothes Underflow wore to the theater in Ægir. Lightweight armor and a tailored skirt come together to form a balance between comfort and defense.

skins.name: Behind the Words
skins.code: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Behind the Words
skins.description: Morgan's outfit for when she's drafting her next work. A classic windbreaker makes an odd pairing for form-fitting innerwear, a bold statement showing that a serious attitude and a rebellious personality don't have to clash.
skins.howToObtain: Reach Level 25 in Path of Trials

skins.name: Staring into the Abyss
skins.code: EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Staring into the Abyss
skins.description: Clothes Ulpianus wore when taking charge of the Abyssal Hunter Program. The consul's transformation is already complete, yet the ceremonial sword in his hand has taken on a great weight.

skins.name: Cloud in Foreign Lands
skins.code: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Cloud in Foreign Lands
skins.description: Clothes Windscoot wears while enjoying a solo trip in faraway lands during a break from work. A comfy short-sleeved shirt paired with lightweight sneakers allows him to enjoy this moment of relaxing freedom.

skins.name: Condolence
skins.description: Attire worn by Civilight Eterna during her Deep Dive into Theresa 's data. Through the veil of time, she spots memories sealed by the dead.

skins.name: Spring in Her Lens
skins.code: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Spring in Her Lens
skins.description: Clothes Xingzhu wore to her nutritional science course graduation ceremony. With a billowing deep blue robe paired with a lilac Yanese satin jacket, she is ready for the lens to capture her smile
skins.release: Such is the Joy of Our Reunion Rerun

skins.name: My Fellow Newsboy
skins.code: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/My Fellow Newsboy
skins.description: Outfit Greyy wears when delivering newspapers. Durable jacket, sturdy boots, and checkered scarf mean he has no need to fear wind nor rain while making his way through the plazas and alleys.

skins.name: Charm of The Tiles
skins.code: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Charm of the Tiles
skins.description: 红隼在棋牌茶室游玩时的穿着。布面裙裤搭配皮衣与手包，引出雅致魅力的同时，尽显穿戴者洒脱风范。
skins.howToObtain: Red Wine Championship Committee ( 350 Cork Wine Stopper )

skins.name: Bedtime Story
skins.description: 水灯心为自己挑选的“家居服”。即使不常有在温暖室内停驻享受的时刻，它也能为匆忙的人带来片刻的宁静。

skins.name: Night Watcher
skins.description: Handmade by Lungmen craftsman, this stylish outfit combines comfortable materials with cutting-edge tech and traditional handicraft. Custom-made services are also available. Fireproof.
skins.howToObtain: Certificate Store ( 40 Distinction Certificate or 400 Universal Certificate )

skins.name: Ageless Afterglow
skins.description: Handcrafted by Lungmen artisans, this tailor-made dress is comfortable, beautiful, and accentuates one's figure. By popular request, it has been made to be a bit sportier than the standard line.

skins.name: Doctor of Faces
skins.description: Handcrafted by Lungmen artisans, with a design concept more inclined towards the East, its main appeal is to highlight the wearer's personality. Onlookers can sense the simplicities and trends of Lungmen.

skins.name: Healing Hand, Evil Heart
skins.description: Handmade in Lungmen , the outfit includes multiple pieces of clothing that can be mixed and matched based on the customer's mood. The details in the outfit have been adjusted according to his needs, and includes an old-fashioned medicine box.
skins.howToObtain: Crystallization Sanctuary ( 980 Crystal Contract Bounty ) Certificate Store ( 40 Distinction Certificate or 400 Universal Certificate )

skins.name: Dusk Wisteria
skins.description: Handmade in Lungmen , tailor-fitted with special consideration to exotic design elements. The outfit has been improved in accordance with the customer's preference to incorporate Yan 's novel trends.

skins.name: Everything is a Miracle
skins.description: A silky and delicate satin surface, perfectly fitted to the wearer's body shape. Blue-green envelops the body, invoking an ancient charm. After completing the outfit's design, the client draws it into existence, ready-to-wear, with a stroke of the brush.

skins.name: Along the Corridor
skins.description: Made by Lungmen craftsmen from premium Shangshu silk. Elegant and classical patterns with cyan lining make for a dignified outfit.
skins.image: /five-star-skins/Kroos the Keen Glint - Along the Corridor.webp

skins.name: Illumination That of Daylights
skins.description: Made by Lungmen tailors. The gauze lining at the hem softens the lines, as does the matching white shawl.
skins.release: Where Vernal Winds Will Never Blow

skins.name: Alighting
skins.description: Magnum opus of a Yumen craftsman, given to a traveler heading on a long journey. In the hope that men and might need no longer be a burden, that he can wander for myriad li with ease.

skins.name: Yearly Present
skins.description: Purestream dons new clothes and brings a gift for her visit, the trendy multi-layered style unable to hide the bright colors of Yan—the hem's red lining and the pendants on her staff and her waist come together in harmonious ingenuity.
